title: Validate workflow_run origin in chained_e2e before using the repo_name artifact

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a clear and actionable report regarding a security flaw in the chained_e2e.yml workflow where unverified repo_name artifacts from fork PRs can lead to checkout of arbitrary repositories in workflow_run context.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The fix requires adding a condition in .github/workflows/chained_e2e.yml to verify that workflow_run events originate from the base repository before consuming the artifact.

summary.problem: chained_e2e.yml consumes the repo_name artifact produced by trigger_e2e.yml without validating that the triggering workflow_run originated from the base repository.
summary.root_cause: download_repo_name does not check whether github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name equals github.repository, allowing fork PR artifacts to specify arbitrary repository checkout targets for downstream E2E jobs.
summary.context: Gating download_repo_name on github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name == github.repository ensures runs from fork PRs safely fall back to the base repository and head SHA.

steps: In .github/workflows/chained_e2e.yml, update the 'if' condition of the download_repo_name job so that workflow_run triggers require github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name == github.repository.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: download_repo_name will only execute and consume artifacts for workflow_run events originating from the base repository, falling back to base repo/sha for fork PR runs.
verification_steps: Test workflow_run behavior with both same-repo and fork PR triggers.
